verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only adjacent material. A marketing line says Crossplane can encapsulate policies and guardrails behind a custom API layer, and it inherits Kubernetes RBAC from the host platform. Neither documents a policy-as-code engine or check that evaluates proposed infrastructure changes and blocks non-compliant ones before apply. Deletion protection via Usages is a related but different control, and CLI rendering and testing of functions is a developer building block, not policy enforcement.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce policy-as-code checks that block non-compliant infrastructure changes before apply
